laws.rule: Gorongosa National Park does not currently allow self-drive safaris and offers guided safaris. Under 10s cannot use open safari vehicles; closed vehicles may be available by arrangement. Canoeing and the Mount Gorongosa/Coffee Tour are for ages 12 and over. This is not a ban on driving an arrival vehicle to the camp.

Gorongosa: camp quiet after 21:00, no disturbing other guests or wildlife, no feeding wildlife, no litter, fires only in designated pits, and no removing plants, animals or natural/cultural items without permission. Bicycles, motorbikes, skates and skateboards need prior arrangement. No pets, with a guide-dog exception requiring park-management permission and vaccination/permit documentation. Declare firearms, dangerous weapons, explosives, traps and poisons at the gate.

Gorongosa allows alcohol consumption only in its restaurant, campsite and guest rooms, not other public park areas. The posted cigarette rule concerns proper disposal, not a published blanket smoking ban.

closures: Gorongosa publishes activities 1 March-15 December and Chitengo camping 1 April-15 December; rainy-season visitor closure from mid-December. Roads can remain closed after seasonal reopening. Gate hours: March-July 06:00-18:00; August-September 05:30-18:00; October-December 05:00-18:30, subject to the seasonal closure. These are park-local times; no January/February access inferred.
